description: Show one of your saved private offers and its current recorded choice. First use offer_quest or list_quest_offers to get its id. Optional interactive card: its buttons call respond_quest_offer themselves, so never repeat that write after a button action. Without UI the same saved draft and choice are returned as JSON.
